allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Nagreeka Exports Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on October 01, 2025. Further to our communication dated September 26, 2025 we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors ( Board ) of the Company, have at its meeting held today i.e. October 01, 2025, considered and approved the following matters:1.
